name: kali-lab
description: Connect Codex to an existing Kali Linux VM using Kali's official MCP package over SSH.

interface.shortDescription: Use Kali tools on your own lab VM through SSH.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the official Kali MCP package on a user-managed Kali VM. Requires a local SSH alias named kali-lab and the Kali API server running on the VM.
defaultPrompt: Use Kali Lab to check the health of my Kali VM.
Use Kali Lab to run an authorized Nmap scan against my lab target.
